adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: When the Avengers storm the Sokovia base, Dr. List urges Strucker to send out the twins. Strucker calls it too soon, then tells List he will surrender.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Strucker's HYDRA scientist, who urges him to send out the twins.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: List's HYDRA boss, who plans to surrender as the Avengers storm the base.
adds.evidence: List and Strucker argue over sending the twins out during the raid; Strucker tells List he will surrender before List is killed going for his data.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Fury waits for the team at the Barton farm and pushes them to plan against Ultron, and Bruce works out that Ultron's next move is a new body from Helen Cho.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The old spymaster who rallies Bruce and the team at the farm.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist who works out Ultron's next move as Fury rallies the team.
adds.evidence: At the farmhouse Fury urges the team to plan; Banner deduces Ultron will force Cho to build him a vibranium body.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Steve tries to stop Bruce and Tony from bringing their new synthetic body to life, and the team turns on itself over it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who tries to stop Bruce bringing the synthetic body to life.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend whose work on the synthetic body Steve tries to stop.
adds.evidence: The Avengers fight among themselves over Stark and Banner's decision to upload J.A.R.V.I.S. into the synthetic body.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Thor's lightning brings to life the synthetic body Bruce and Tony have built, and the being that wakes is the Vision.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger whose lightning wakes the body Bruce helped build.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who builds the body Thor's lightning brings to life.
adds.evidence: Stark and Banner upload J.A.R.V.I.S. into the synthetic body; Thor returns and helps activate it, and it becomes Vision.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: After Johannesburg, Hill calls Clint on the Quinjet and tells the team to lie low, and Clint takes them to his farm.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The officer who calls Clint and tells the team to lie low.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Hill calls on the Quinjet, who knows a place to hide.
adds.evidence: Hill calls Barton while he pilots the Quinjet and recommends a hideout; Barton says he knows where to go and takes them to his home.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Clint hides the team at his secret family farm, where his children greet Natasha as Auntie Nat.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's best friend, already part of his secret family.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Natasha's best friend, whose children call her Auntie Nat.
adds.evidence: The team hides at Barton's farmhouse with his family; his children call Natasha Auntie Nat.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: In Seoul, Clint and Steve fight Ultron alongside Natasha and get the synthetic body away from him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Clint fights beside in Seoul to take the body from Ultron.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who fights beside Steve in Seoul to take the body from Ultron.
adds.evidence: Rogers, Romanoff and Barton fight Ultron in Seoul and retrieve the synthetic body.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Clint hides the team, Thor among them, at his family farm, until Thor leaves to seek answers about his vision.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Clint shelters at his farm before he leaves.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who shelters Thor at his family farm.
adds.evidence: The team hides at Barton's farmhouse; Thor departs from there to consult Selvig about his vision.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Clint hides Tony and the rest of the team at his secret family farm after Johannesburg.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Clint shelters at his secret farm.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who shelters Tony at his secret family farm.
adds.evidence: After Johannesburg the team goes into hiding at Barton's farmhouse with his family, where Fury talks to Stark.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Thor seeks out Selvig in England for help understanding his vision, and Selvig leads him to the waters that can show him more.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Selvig helps make sense of his vision.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend Thor turns to for help with his vision.
adds.evidence: Thor departs to consult Dr. Erik Selvig on the apocalyptic future he saw in his hallucination.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Rhodey flies in as War Machine from Fury's Helicarrier and fights Ultron's drones over Sokovia beside Tony.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's best friend, fighting beside him over Sokovia.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's best friend, who flies in as War Machine over Sokovia.
adds.evidence: Fury arrives in a Helicarrier with Rhodes and sends War Machine into the battle where the Avengers fight Ultron's army.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Rhodes and Vision both join the new Avengers that Steve and Natasha train at the new base.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow recruit in the new Avengers lineup.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow recruit in the new Avengers lineup.
adds.evidence: Rogers and Romanoff prepare to train new Avengers: Rhodes, Vision, Sam Wilson and Wanda.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: At the Avengers' party Hill teases Steve over a remark from the raid that Natasha passed on to her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow agent who passes Hill a joke at Steve's expense.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow agent whom Natasha tells about Steve's remark.
adds.evidence: Hill makes fun of Rogers at the party for a comment he made during the raid, which Romanoff had told her.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Hill helps Fury bring a hidden Helicarrier to Sokovia, and the two fight off a robot that crashes onto the bridge.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's old boss, beside her on the Helicarrier bridge.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand, at his side on the Helicarrier bridge.
adds.evidence: Fury and Hill take the Helicarrier to Sokovia; when a sentry crashes onto the bridge Hill shoots it and Fury destroys it.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: At the new compound Fury tells Natasha where the Hulk's Quinjet was last seen, and she asks whether he planned for her and Bruce to fall for each other.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A trusted friend who tells Natasha where the Hulk's Quinjet went.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A trusted friend who asks Fury about her and Bruce.
adds.evidence: Fury arrives at the compound, tells Romanoff the Quinjet's last known location, and she asks if he knew she and Banner would get feelings for each other.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Sam joins the new Avengers that Natasha and Steve train at the new base.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend and new recruit Natasha trains.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who trains Sam with the new Avengers.
adds.evidence: Rogers and Romanoff prepare to train new Avengers including Sam Wilson.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Steve and Natasha take charge of the new Avengers together at the new base.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's close friend, leading the new Avengers with her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's close friend, leading the new Avengers with him.
adds.evidence: As Stark leaves and Barton retires, Rogers and Romanoff prepare to train new Avengers.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: At the Barton farm, Natasha needles Tony over his failure to save the world as Fury rallies the team.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Natasha needles over his failure at the farm.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who needles Tony at the farm over his failure.
adds.evidence: At the farmhouse Romanoff mocks Stark for his failure to save the world while Fury rallies the team.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Fury brings a hidden Helicarrier to Sokovia so Steve can get the city's people out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The Captain whose rescue Fury makes possible with a Helicarrier.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's old boss, who brings a Helicarrier to save Sokovia's people.
adds.evidence: Fury arrives in a Helicarrier with S.H.I.E.L.D. agents to evacuate civilians while the Avengers fight Ultron's army.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Fury waits at the Barton farm and talks Tony back on track after Wanda's vision, telling him he can fight hate and war.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A founding Avenger Fury talks back on track at the farm.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The old spymaster who steadies Tony at the farm.
adds.evidence: At the homestead Fury speaks to Stark in private after Wanda's visions, reminding him he did not invent hate and war but can fight them.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Sam joins the new Avengers that Steve trains at the new base.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's close friend, who trains him with the new Avengers.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's close friend and new recruit to the Avengers.
adds.evidence: Rogers and Romanoff prepare to train new Avengers including Sam Wilson.
